name: Pete Stegemeyer
biography: Pete Stegemeyer is both a Senior Security Engineer and one of the world’s leading heist experts. Pete has served as a consultant for Vice, National Geographic, and was a featured expert on the History Channel’s series “History’s Greatest Heists.” He is the author of the best selling book Heist: An Inside Look at the World’s 100 Greatest Heists, Cons and Capers and hosts of the popular podcast “I Can Steal That!”
